metadata.scenario: A business owner requests a quote for hosting a wellness seminar for their employees. Category: Quote Request. Outcome: quote_provided.

transcription.text: Thank you for calling CareFirst Home Health, how can I help you today? Hi, this is Thomas White. I was referred here by a support group. I'm looking for services for my mother who has Alzheimer's. I’m glad you called, Thomas. We offer specialized dementia care and respite services. Can you tell me more about your mother’s needs? Sure, she needs regular assistance with daily activities, and I could really use some respite care to help me manage. Absolutely, we can provide personal care assistance and companion care for her. What specific days are you considering? I’m thinking about a few days a week, maybe Monday, Wednesday, and Friday. How does that work? That should work well. Our personal care assistants can help with daily living activities during those days. That sounds great! Can you give me an idea of the costs involved? Of course! Our personal care assistance ranges from $28 to $35 per hour. Would you like to discuss the specific hours you need? Yes, I think I would need about four hours each visit. How does the scheduling process work? Once we finalize the details, our care coordinator will set up a care plan and match you with a suitable caregiver. That sounds perfect. What about respite care for when I need a break? Our respite care is priced between $30 and $38 per hour. We can arrange that on your preferred days as well. Okay, and how do I go about getting started? I can connect you with our Care Coordinator, Lisa Chen, who will help you with the care plan and scheduling. Would you like me to do that now? Yes, please! That would be really helpful. Great! Let me transfer you to Lisa. Also, we can discuss setting up a wellness seminar for caregivers if you're interested. A wellness seminar? What would that involve? We offer seminars focusing on caregiver support, stress management, and best practices for dementia care. Would you like a quote for that? Yes, I think that would be beneficial for my support group. Perfect! I’ll make sure Lisa has all your details to provide a quote for the seminar. Thank you! I appreciate your help today. You’re welcome, Thomas! I’ll transfer you to Lisa now. Just a moment, please. Lisa, I have a caller for you, Thomas White, interested in dementia care and a wellness seminar. Please take it from here.
